newsitem.title: USA: Airbus aim is 50 pct of world plane market - Daimler.
newsitem.headline: Airbus aim is 50 pct of world plane market - Daimler.

text.p: Europe's Airbus consortium must, in the long term, seek 50 percent of the world's aircraft market, Juergen Schrempp told a news conference on Wednesday.
"Now that there are basically two major manufacturers of commercial aircraft in the world, our long-term aim must be to get 50 percent of the world market," he said.
"That has to be the target. When and how it will be achieved remains to be seen," he said.
Schrempp said Europe's defense aircraft companies had to consolidate to compete.
"We have to consolidate in Europe, or else we have got no chance whatsoever," he said.
"We have to go along the way that U.S. companies have gone."
